entries.name: VetLife Hospital
entries.duty: Open 24/7 with an emergency service; also reachable on WhatsApp.
entries.note: Own page says '7/24 veterinar dəstək', 'Daim açıq', '24/7 təcili yardım xidməti mövcuddur'. No street address on the page, only district/postcode/coordinates (40.380000, 49.837889). Page images point to vetlifehospital.az, which could not be opened.

duty_i18n.pl: Całodobowo z pomocą w nagłych przypadkach; dostępne także przez WhatsApp.
duty_i18n.cs: Nonstop s pohotovostní službou; dostupné i přes WhatsApp.
duty_i18n.sv: Öppet dygnet runt, alla dagar, med akutjour; nås även på WhatsApp.
duty_i18n.da: Døgnåben med akutvagt; kan også kontaktes på WhatsApp.

entries.name: AARC Veterinary Clinic (Azerbaijan Animal Rescue Center)
entries.duty: Mon-Sat 10:00-18:00, closed Sunday; emergency doctor on call during working hours; home visits within 50 km of Baku.
entries.note: Own page; same number is the emergency hotline; no 24 h statement ('overnight care' mentioned without hours).

duty_i18n.pl: Pon.–sob. 10:00–18:00, w niedzielę zamknięte; lekarz do nagłych przypadków na dyżurze w godzinach pracy; wizyty domowe w promieniu 50 km od Baku.
duty_i18n.cs: Po–So 10:00–18:00, v neděli zavřeno; v pracovní době je k dispozici pohotovostní lékař; návštěvy doma do 50 km od Baku.
duty_i18n.sv: Mån–lör 10.00–18.00, stängt söndagar; jourhavande veterinär under öppettiderna; hembesök inom 50 km från Baku.
duty_i18n.da: Man–lør 10.00–18.00, søn lukket; akutlæge på vagt i åbningstiden; hjemmebesøg inden for 50 km fra Baku.

notes: 2 entries, 1 with 24 h (VetLife Hospital Baku). No duty rota or animal poison line found. Search returned very few Azerbaijani vet sites. AFSA (afsa.gov.az) only surfaced legal PDFs, no clinic list; no Azerbaijan Veterinary Association site found. Not openable: vetlifehospital.az (PROVENANCE_REQUIRED). Not usable (no contact data): Azerbaijan State Agrarian University (Ganja; page only has a "Veterinary clinic" menu link, no clinic contact data - removed at independent check 2026-11-15), Royal Vet (oneclick.az), Research Institute of Veterinary Medicine clinic (Baku, Nizami district). Nothing found for Sumqayit, Lankaran, Gabala.
